module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter	WIDTH = 8,
    parameter 	DEPTH = 16,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters for depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">Data width parameter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">FIFO depth parameter.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define the dual-port RAM instance here
        <instance id="RAM" module_id="dual_port_RAM" />
        
        // Declare internal signals
        <signal id="wen" type="wire">Write enable signal.</signal>
        <signal id="ren" type="wire">Read enable signal.</signal>
        <signal id="waddr" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write address register.</signal>
        <signal id="raddr" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read address register.</signal>
        <signal id="waddr_bin" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Binary representation of write address.</signal>
        <signal id="raddr_bin" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Binary representation of read address.</signal>
        <signal id="wptr" type="reg" width_description="4">Gray code representation of write pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="rptr" type="reg" width_description="4">Gray code representation of read pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="wptr_buff" type="reg" width_description="4">Buffer for write pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="rptr_buff" type="reg" width_description="4">Buffer for read pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="wptr_syn" type="reg" width_description="4">Synchronized write pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="rptr_syn" type="reg" width_description="4">Synchronized read pointer.</signal>
        <signal id="wfull_reg" type="reg">Register for write full signal.</signal>
        <signal id="rempty_reg" type="reg">Register for read empty signal.</signal>
        <signal id="rdata_reg" type="reg" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Register for read data output.</signal>
        
        // Assignments for write and read enables
        assign wen = winc & !wfull;
        assign ren = rinc & !rempty;
        
        // Sequential logic for write address
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull) begin
                waddr <= waddr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for read address
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                raddr <= raddr + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for write pointer
        always @(*) begin
            wptr[3] = waddr_bin[3];
            wptr[2] = waddr_bin[3] ^ waddr_bin[2];
            wptr[1] = waddr_bin[2] ^ waddr_bin[1];
            wptr[0] = waddr_bin[1] ^ waddr_bin[0];
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for read pointer
        always @(*) begin
            rptr[3] = raddr_bin[3];
            rptr[2] = raddr_bin[3] ^ raddr_bin[2];
            rptr[1] = raddr_bin[2] ^ raddr_bin[1];
            rptr[0] = raddr_bin[1] ^ raddr_bin[0];
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for write pointer buffer
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for read pointer buffer
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronization logic for write pointer
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronization logic for read pointer
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Full and empty signal generation
        always @(*) begin
            wfull_reg = (wptr == {~rptr_syn[3], rptr_syn[2:0]});
            rempty_reg = (rptr == wptr_syn);
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign wfull = wfull_reg;
        assign rempty = rempty_reg;
        assign rdata = rdata_reg;
        
        // Connect input/output signals to RAM instance
        <connect_instance id="RAM">
            <port id="wclk" value="wclk" />
            <port id="rclk" value="rclk" />
            <port id="wenc" value="wen" />
            <port id="renc" value="ren" />
            <port id="waddr" value="waddr" />
            <port id="raddr" value="raddr" />
            <port id="wdata" value="wdata" />
            <port id="rdata" value="rdata_reg" />
        </connect_instance>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM implementation goes here
        // Data write controller implementation goes here
        // Data read controller implementation goes here
        // Read pointer synchronizer implementation goes here
        // Write pointer synchronizer implementation goes here
    </implementation>
</module>
